summary: Learn modern warehouse and lakehouse design, ELT, modelling, and governance in 5 days. Build practical architecture skills and apply them immediately.
lede: Modern warehouse and lakehouse design supports reliable analytics platforms by bringing governed reporting and flexible analytical storage together. For data engineers, analytics engineers, BI architects, and data platform leads, the course covers architecture planning, dimensional and layered modelling, incremental ELT pipeline design, data quality and governance controls, and performance tuning through hands-on exercises for consistent BI delivery.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who build, govern, or consume enterprise analytics platforms and need practical guidance on modern warehouse and lakehouse design.
audience: Reporting Analyst dependent on trusted curated datasets
prerequisites: To get the most from this course, you should already be comfortable working with relational databases, basic SQL joins, and core data concepts such as tables, keys, and aggregates. Prior exposure to data warehousing, BI reporting, or ETL/ELT workflows is helpful, but no prior programming experience is needed. The course is positioned at intermediate level, so you can join if you already support reporting, data integration, or analytics delivery and want to move into modern warehouse and lakehouse design.
